newsitem.title: UK: OPEC basket price edged up to $24.38 last week.
newsitem.headline: OPEC basket price edged up to $24.38 last week.

text.p: The price of OPEC's basket of seven crudes edged up to $24.38 per barrel last week from $23.69 the previous week, the OPEC news agency OPECNA said on Monday.

It said that according to figures released by the OPEC Secretariat in Vienna on Monday, the basket price averaged $23.51 a barrel in December 1996 as opposed to $22.23 in November and $23.28 in October.
The basket comprises Algeria's Saharan Blend, Indonesia's Minas, Nigeria's Bonny Light, Saudi Arabia's Arabian Light, Dubai of the UAE, Venezuela's Tia Juana and Mexico's Isthmus.
